races.verdict: NOBLE EXHIBIT can become the third Aidan O'Brien-trained colt since 2021 to follow up victory in the Beresford at the Curragh with a win in the final Group 1 of the season in Britain. races.display_title: Pertemps Network Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Unexposed stayer SEANIECON caught the eye when an unlucky fifth in a listed handicap at Punchestown back in April and looks the type who'll relish the staying test this promises to be. Moon Rocket could be the main threat if recapturing the pick of his novice hurdle form. Ace Of Spades and Idaho Fire also appeal for top yards, with out-and-out stayer Love Of Neymore completing the shortlist. SEANIECON (IRE) MOON ROCKET (IRE) ACE OF SPADES (FR)

races.verdict: KATATE DORI represents a yard that often has their horses cherry-ripe for their early season targets and is 3 lb lower than when going close at C&D on New Year's Day, so gets the verdict. Diamond Dealer had a very good time of things last season for Dan Skelton and has to be respected on his comeback, whilst Here Comes Georgie rates as an interesting recruit for that powerful yard. KATATE DORI (FR) DIAMOND DEALER (IRE) HERE COMES GEORGIE

races.display_title: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap
races.verdict: This is wide open so it could be worth siding with GLAMOROUS BREEZE who scored on all-weather at Lingfield in 2025 and can capitalise on a handy-looking mark now back on an artificial surface for the first time this season. Almaty Star is feared most on the back of a good Leicester second, although both Bona Fortuna and Moulin Booj can also play a prominent role. GLAMOROUS BREEZE ALMATY STAR (IRE) BONA FORTUNA (IRE)
races.betting_forecast: Bona Fortuna (10/3), Rhythm N Hooves (9/2), Night Storm (5/1), Moulin Booj (13/2), Glamorous Breeze (8/1), Almaty Star (10/1), Shes Got A Brother (14/1), Kanishka (14/1), Betsen (14/1), Alondra (16/1), Sugar Hill Babe (25/1), Henrythenate (33/1), Wateen (33/1)

races.verdict: KEV had nothing to spare at Wolverhampton on his most recent outing, but he's still lightly raced for his current yard and a 3 lb rise doesn't look insurmountable. KEV AL SUIL EILE (FR) CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE)
